sthr-hour-1.name: Hour I — First Dark
sthr-hour-1.back_flavor: Lanterns bob across the Square. Somewhere a band is tuning up for midnight. Above it all, one by one, the stars begin to go out.
sthr-hour-1.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour II becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-1.flavor: The whole town has come out to watch the sky. No one is watching the clock.

sthr-hour-2.name: Hour II — Low Water
sthr-hour-2.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: Each investigator draws 1 encounter card.
sthr-hour-2.back_flavor: The tide draws back from the Long Pier, farther than any tide should, and does not come in again. The harbor smells of something left too long in the dark.
sthr-hour-2.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour III becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-2.flavor: Down at the harbor a bell is ringing. No one is there to ring it.

sthr-hour-3.name: Hour III — The Bell Counts
sthr-hour-3.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: Raise Dissonance by 1. If any investigator is at a Church location and your Campaign Log does not record The Thirteenth Toll, raise it by 2 instead.
sthr-hour-3.back_flavor: The church bell counts the hour. Twelve. A pause, long enough to hope. Thirteen.
sthr-hour-3.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour IV becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-3.flavor: Somewhere above the rooftops, a bell begins to count.

sthr-hour-4.name: Hour IV — The Road Gives Way
sthr-hour-4.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: The lead investigator chooses one of the revealed locations with the fewest clues, other than The Square. Until the Hourglass next advances or rewinds, the chosen location is impassable. Each investigator there moves to a connecting location of their choice (this does not place doom).
sthr-hour-4.back_flavor: Out past the Milestones the road simply stops being there. The walkers on it do not break stride.
sthr-hour-4.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour V becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-4.flavor: Out at the edge of town, the lamps go out one street at a time.

sthr-hour-5.name: Hour V — The Streets Empty
sthr-hour-5.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: Advance The Appointed's Approach to at least Sensed.
sthr-hour-5.back_flavor: The fair's music plays on for no one. Doors stand open along every street. The town has gone somewhere without moving.
sthr-hour-5.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour VI becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-5.flavor: The crowd in the Square thins. Nobody remembers going home.

sthr-hour-6.name: Hour VI — The Wrong Sky
sthr-hour-6.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the loop. If your Campaign Log records What the Almanac Hid, instead: until the end of the loop, the chaos bag holds 1 fewer Static token than its band calls for (never fewer than 0). (This does not stack: if Hour VI has already resolved this loop, it has no further effect.)
sthr-hour-6.back_flavor: The sky is wrong in a new way now: a starless patch the shape of an open door, fraying at its edges.
sthr-hour-6.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour VII becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-6.flavor: Look up. Count the stars. Count them again.

sthr-hour-7.name: Hour VII — The Guest Approaches
sthr-hour-7.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: Advance The Appointed's Approach to at least Emerging. If your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name, exhaust The Appointed.
sthr-hour-7.back_flavor: Every dog in Ambergrove faces the same way. Something is coming up the hill toward the Square, politely, with all the time in the world.
sthr-hour-7.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour VIII becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-7.flavor: Somewhere below the Square, footsteps on the hill road: unhurried, certain.

sthr-hour-8.name: Hour VIII — Almost
sthr-hour-8.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: Raise Dissonance by 2. Advance The Appointed's Approach to Arrived. Until the end of the loop, each enemy gets +1 fight (including enemies that enter play later; this does not stack).
sthr-hour-8.back_flavor: One minute to midnight. It has been one minute to midnight for a very long time. The seam in the sky pulls taut.
sthr-hour-8.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour IX becomes the current agenda.
sthr-hour-8.flavor: The minute hand of the town clock trembles a hair short of the twelve.

sthr-hour-9.name: Hour IX — The Appointed Hour
sthr-hour-9.text: Forced – When the Hourglass advances to this Hour: In the Prologue, (→R2). In the finale, the finale ends and the contest is not reached. Otherwise, the loop ends (→Loop Resolution 1), unless your Campaign Log records The Way the Night Breaks and you begin the finale instead.
sthr-hour-9.back_flavor: The occultation completes, exactly as the almanac promised.
sthr-hour-9.flavor: The last of the stars goes out.

sthr-losthour.name: Lost Hour
sthr-losthour.text: Revelation – Advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour.

sthr-slippage.name: Slippage
sthr-slippage.text:
Surge.
Revelation – Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round.

sthr-waitingcongregation.name: The Waiting Congregation
sthr-waitingcongregation.text:
Sleepwalking.
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
While Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, The Waiting Congregation gains hunter.

sthr-drownedchoir.name: The Drowned Choir
sthr-drownedchoir.text:
Sleepwalking. Aloof.
Forced – After The Drowned Choir wakes: Each investigator at its location takes 1 horror. (Limit once per loop.)

sthr-familiarface.name: Familiar Face
sthr-familiarface.text:
Sleepwalking.
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
Spawn – The location of the investigator with the most Memory on their cards (the lead investigator breaks ties).
Forced – After you defeat Familiar Face: Place 1 Memory on your investigator card.
sthr-familiarface.flavor: You will remember this face too.

sthr-lamplighterecho.name: The Lamplighter's Echo
sthr-lamplighterecho.text:
Sleepwalking.
While The Ambergrove Lamp is in play, The Lamplighter's Echo is not Sleepwalking, even while The Lantern Room's lamp is lit, and gains retaliate.

sthr-wrongturn.name: Wrong Turn
sthr-wrongturn.text: Revelation – Test [agi] (3). If you fail, move to a connecting location of the lead investigator's choice. This move does not place doom on the current Hour.
sthr-wrongturn.flavor: The map is not where you left it.

sthr-rewind.name: Stutter
sthr-rewind.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Test [int] (3). If you fail, place 1 of your clues on the location where you last discovered a clue during your most recent turn. If you cannot, take 2 horror.

sthr-deadair.name: Dead Air
sthr-deadair.text: Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of your next turn. Until then, each Static token is −4 instead of −3.

sthr-loopnotices.name: The Loop Notices You
sthr-loopnotices.text: Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, raise Dissonance by 1. If, during your most recent turn, you played or committed a Recollection or paid “raise Dissonance” as a cost, raise it by 2 instead.

sthr-yearinanight.name: A Year in a Night
sthr-yearinanight.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. If you fail by 2 or more, also gain 1 Year (record it now; it takes effect Between Loops).

sthr-forgotten.name: What You've Forgotten
sthr-forgotten.text: Revelation – Test [int] (3). If you fail, remove 1 Memory from among the cards you control. If you cannot, take 1 horror.

sthr-oldbones.name: Old Bones
sthr-oldbones.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Test [com] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. If you are Elder or Ancient, take 2 damage instead.
sthr-oldbones.flavor: Your body remembers what your mind won't.

sthr-crossing.name: The Crossing
sthr-crossing.text: Revelation – Advance The Appointed's Approach by 1 stage and place 1 doom on the current Hour.

sthr-loc-square.name: The Square
sthr-loc-square.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. Hardly anyone looks at you twice, and those who do forget you by midnight.

sthr-loc-longpier.name: The Long Pier
sthr-loc-longpier.flavor: You are in Ambergrove for your own reasons. Soon, you will not remember why.
sthr-loc-longpier.unrevealed_flavor: Planks run out over black water. At the far end, someone is waiting for a boat that is not coming.
sthr-loc-longpier.text: [action]: Test [wil] (2). If you succeed, place 1 Memory on your investigator card. (Group limit once per game.)

sthr-loc-almanacsteps.name: The Almanac Steps
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.text: Forced – After you enter The Almanac Steps: Raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.unrevealed_flavor: The printing house's stone steps, worn hollow in the middle. A light burns behind the upper windows.
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.flavor: Worn hollow by a hundred years of townsfolk coming to read the date.

tokens.text: −1. If Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, −2 instead.
−2. If you fail by 2 or more, raise Dissonance by 1.
−2. If The Appointed's Approach is Emerging or later, take 1 horror.
−3. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current Hour.

back_tokens.text: −2. If Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, −3 instead.
−4. If The Appointed's Approach is Sensed or later, take 1 horror. If it is Arrived, also take 1 damage.
−5. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current Hour.

sthr-loc-lanternroom.name: The Lantern Room
sthr-loc-lanternroom.text: When your Campaign Log records The Lamp Remembers, this location enters play calm side up.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.flavor: The light remembers a path the dark has forgotten.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.back_text:
Calm side (your Campaign Log records The Lamp Remembers).
[action]: Light the lamp. It stays lit until the end of the loop.
While The Lantern Room's lamp is lit, each Echo in the Lighthouse and Sunken Road districts is Sleepwalking while Dissonance is in the Calm or Glitch band (unless another effect says it is not Sleepwalking), and The Dark That Waits treats investigators here as not at The Lantern Room.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.back_flavor: You know how to light it now. Some part of you always did.

sthr-loc-windingstair.name: The Winding Stair
sthr-loc-windingstair.text:
Investigators cannot move into The Lantern Room except with the ability below.
[action]: Test [agi] (2). If you succeed, move to The Lantern Room. If you fail, take 1 damage.
sthr-loc-windingstair.unrevealed_flavor: Iron steps spiral up into the dark. You can hear them ring under feet that are not yours.
sthr-loc-windingstair.unrevealed_text: Investigators cannot move into The Lantern Room except with The Winding Stair's [action] ability.

sthr-loc-keepersquarters.name: The Keeper's Quarters
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.text: [action][action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per round.)
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.unrevealed_flavor: A narrow door at the foot of the tower, painted the same green as a hundred years of salt allowed.
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.flavor: Eight lines in his own hand, each signed with his own name. The ninth is blank, and wet.

sthr-darkthatwaits.name: The Dark That Waits
sthr-darkthatwaits.text: Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. If you are at The Lantern Room, take 2 horror instead.

sthr-loc-nave.name: The Nave
sthr-loc-nave.flavor: The congregation is still here. They have been kneeling since the first toll.
sthr-loc-nave.unrevealed_flavor: Water laps at the church doors. Inside, lamplight lies on it like oil.
sthr-loc-nave.text: Forced – After you enter The Nave: Test [wil] (2). If you fail, take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-belfry.name: The Belfry
sthr-loc-belfry.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times. The thirteenth is the sound the night is stuck on.
sthr-loc-belfry.unrevealed_flavor: The bell rope disappears up through a hole in the ceiling. It is swaying, though there is no wind.
sthr-loc-belfry.text: Forced – After you enter The Belfry: If your Campaign Log does not record The Thirteenth Toll, raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-loc-belfry.unrevealed_text: Forced – When Hour III is reached: Reveal The Belfry.

sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.name: The Flooded Crypt
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.text: Forced – At the end of the round: Each investigator at The Flooded Crypt takes 1 damage.
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.unrevealed_flavor: Steps go down into the water and do not come up again.
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.flavor: The water is colder than the sea it came from.
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.unrevealed_text: Closed. It opens when The Hour Was Wrong becomes the current act. Once your Campaign Log records The Hour Was Wrong, it enters play open (revealed).

sthr-loc-vestry.name: The Vestry
sthr-loc-vestry.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Lower Dissonance by 1. (Group limit once per round.)
sthr-loc-vestry.unrevealed_flavor: A side door, a brass plate, a key left in the lock as though someone meant to come back.
sthr-loc-vestry.flavor: Vestments hang in a row, stiff with salt. One peg is empty.

sthr-thirteen.name: Thirteen
sthr-thirteen.text: Revelation – Place 1 doom on the current Hour. If you are at a Church location, also raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-risingwater.name: Rising Water
sthr-risingwater.text:
Revelation – Attach Rising Water to your location. Attached location gets +1 shroud.
Forced – When the Hourglass advances: Discard Rising Water.
sthr-risingwater.flavor: It rises between the strokes of the bell, and falls back when the hour sounds.

sthr-loc-milestones.name: The Milestones
sthr-loc-milestones.flavor: The road between the town and the shore, counted out in stones that never change.
sthr-loc-milestones.unrevealed_flavor: Stone markers along the verge, each one carved with a number. The numbers do not go in order.
sthr-loc-milestones.text: Forced – After you discover 1 or more clues at The Milestones: If your Campaign Log does not record The Road Remembers, test [wil] (2). If you fail, take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-lowbridge.name: The Low Bridge
sthr-loc-lowbridge.flavor: The water never quite reaches the top. It never quite goes down.
sthr-loc-lowbridge.unrevealed_flavor: A humpbacked bridge over a stream that should not be this deep.
sthr-loc-lowbridge.text: Forced – After you enter The Low Bridge: Test [agi] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage.

sthr-loc-turning.name: The Turning
sthr-loc-turning.text: [action] Raise Dissonance by 2: Rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour. (Group limit once per loop.)
sthr-loc-turning.unrevealed_flavor: The road bends toward the shore and out of sight. Every hooded walker takes the bend the same way.
sthr-loc-turning.flavor: Every walker takes the bend the same way. You could turn back.

sthr-bridgeremembers.name: The Bridge Remembers
sthr-bridgeremembers.text: Revelation – If you moved into or out of The Low Bridge during your most recent turn or since it ended, place 1 doom on the current Hour. Otherwise, The Bridge Remembers gains surge.

sthr-loc-townhallsteps.name: The Town Hall Steps
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.text: When your Campaign Log records The Sheriff Is Already Dead, this location enters play calm side up.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.flavor: The sheriff gives the same speech to the same crowd. He has been giving it since ten o'clock.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.back_text:
Calm side (your Campaign Log records The Sheriff Is Already Dead).
[free]: Name an Hour after the current Hour, other than Hour IX. The next time the Hourglass advances to it this loop, cancel its Forced ability. (Group limit once per loop.)
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.back_flavor: The speech is the night's program, hour by hour. You know it by heart now, and you know which line to interrupt.

sthr-loc-recordsoffice.name: The Records Office
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.text: [action] Spend 2 clues: An investigator at The Records Office who gained Years from a card effect during this loop loses 1 of those Years. (Group limit once per loop.)
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.unrevealed_flavor: Town Hall's back rooms: ledgers, deeds, and the smell of dust that has been disturbed recently.
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.flavor: Every decision the town ever made, filed where no one will look.

sthr-loc-well.name: The Well
sthr-loc-well.text: Forced – After you enter The Well: If your Campaign Log does not record The Sheriff Is Already Dead, take 1 horror.
sthr-loc-well.unrevealed_flavor: An old stone well at the edge of the Square, capped with a board. Something has scratched at the board from beneath.
sthr-loc-well.flavor: The board over its mouth is scored on the underside.

sthr-samespeech.name: The Same Speech
sthr-samespeech.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. Unless your Campaign Log records The Vote That Never Ends, take 1 additional horror for every 3 completed loops (maximum 3).
sthr-samespeech.flavor: Word for word. Pause for pause. Applause on the same beat.

sthr-crowdturns.name: The Crowd Turns
sthr-crowdturns.text: Revelation – Until the end of the round, each Echo enemy in play is not Sleepwalking. Ready each Echo enemy in play. If there is no Echo enemy in play, The Crowd Turns gains surge.

sthr-loc-wheel.name: The Wheel
sthr-loc-wheel.text: Forced – After the Hourglass advances: Each investigator at The Wheel takes 1 horror.
sthr-loc-wheel.unrevealed_flavor: The great wheel turns against the wrong sky, every car lit, every car empty.
sthr-loc-wheel.flavor: From the top, the whole town holds still.

sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.name: The Hall of Mirrors
sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.flavor: Every mirror shows you at a different age. None of them shows you leaving.
sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.unrevealed_flavor: A painted door: SEE YOURSELF AS OTHERS SEE YOU. The paint is still wet.
sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.text: [action]: You gain 1 Year (record it now; it takes effect Between Loops). Place 2 Memory on your investigator card. (Group limit once per loop.)

sthr-loc-ticketbooth.name: The Ticket Booth
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.text: Forced – After you enter The Ticket Booth: If your Campaign Log does not record You hold the ticket, lose 1 resource.
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.unrevealed_flavor: A striped booth at the fair's gate. The window is lit. The ticket-taker is not looking at you, and then he is.
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.flavor: ADMIT ONE. No price is posted.

sthr-wheelsturn.name: The Wheel's Turn
sthr-wheelsturn.text: Revelation – Place 1 doom on the current Hour. Then, each investigator gains 1 resource.
sthr-wheelsturn.flavor: Every car pays out. Nobody notices the hour go round.

sthr-reflectionlies.name: Your Reflection Lies
sthr-reflectionlies.text: Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. If you are at The Hall of Mirrors, take 2 horror instead and add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round.

sthr-loc-readingroom.name: The Reading Room
sthr-loc-readingroom.flavor: Someone has read every book in it a hundred times. The margins are full of a hand you almost recognize.
sthr-loc-readingroom.unrevealed_flavor: Shelves to the ceiling, and a long table laid with open almanacs, all turned to the same page.
sthr-loc-readingroom.text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue at The Reading Room: Place 1 Memory on your investigator card. (Group limit once per loop.)

sthr-loc-press.name: The Press
sthr-loc-press.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Remove from the chaos bag 1 Static token that a card effect added until the end of a turn or round. (Group limit once per round.)
sthr-loc-press.unrevealed_flavor: The iron press stands inked and ready. The type in its bed has already been set.
sthr-loc-press.flavor: It has printed the same page all night. The ink is always wet.

sthr-loc-sealedstudy.name: The Sealed Study
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.text: [free] During your turn, if your Campaign Log records The Way the Night Breaks: Begin the finale.
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.unrevealed_flavor: A study door that no key in Ambergrove fits.
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.flavor: Inside, it is eleven o'clock exactly, and always has been.
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.unrevealed_text: Closed. It opens when The Appointed's Name becomes the current act. Once your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name, it enters play open (revealed).

sthr-pagethatwasnt.name: The Page That Wasn't
sthr-pagethatwasnt.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Test [int] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for every 6 banked Memory, rounded up (maximum 3).
sthr-pagethatwasnt.flavor: In one loop she found a page that was not there in the others.

sthr-inkrunsbackward.name: Ink Runs Backward
sthr-inkrunsbackward.text: Revelation – The next time a clue would be discovered at your current location this round, cancel that discovery. (This effect stays with that location.)

sthr-studydoor.name: The Study Door
sthr-studydoor.text: Revelation – If The Sealed Study is closed, add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Otherwise, The Study Door gains surge.

sthr-loc-hubsquare.name: The Square
sthr-loc-hubsquare.text:
Each loop begins here.
Forced – After an investigator moves along a connection between The Square and a location in another district, if it is the first time an investigator has moved along that connection this round: Place 1 doom on the current Hour.
[action]: Resign. You cannot resign during the finale.
sthr-loc-hubsquare.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. Hardly anyone looks at you twice, and those who do forget you by midnight.

sthr-act-firsthour.name: The First Hour
sthr-act-firsthour.text:
Objective – If the current Hour is Hour VIII or later, investigators at The Almanac Steps may, as a group, spend 2 [perinv] clues to advance.
If Hour IX is reached first, (→R2).
sthr-act-firsthour.flavor: The almanac promised the occultation at midnight. It is eleven, and the sky is already wrong.
sthr-act-firsthour.back_flavor: You were standing on the right step at the right second. You watched the occultation complete, and you watched something reach through, and not finish reaching. When the night folds, you fold with it on purpose.

sthr-story-firstreset.name: The First Reset
sthr-story-firstreset.text:
The Prologue ends. In your Campaign Log, record You Are Unstuck.
Then turn to the Prologue resolutions in the Campaign Guide and read the one that applies.

sthr-act-lamp.name: Light the Lamp
sthr-act-lamp.text: Objective – [action] Investigators at The Lantern Room spend 2 [perinv] clues, as a group: Test [wil] or [com] (3). Only an investigator at The Lantern Room may trigger this ability. If you succeed, advance. If you fail, place the spent clues on The Lantern Room.
sthr-act-lamp.flavor: The lamp is dark. It has never, in any loop, been lit.
sthr-act-lamp.back_flavor: The wick takes on the third try. For the first time in more nights than anyone can count, the beam swings out across the water, and down on the Sunken Road every walker stops and turns to face the light.
sthr-act-lamp.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Lamp Remembers.
The Lantern Room's lamp is lit until the end of this loop. While it is lit, each Echo in the Lighthouse and Sunken Road districts is Sleepwalking while Dissonance is in the Calm or Glitch band (unless another effect says it is not Sleepwalking), and The Dark That Waits treats investigators at The Lantern Room as not at The Lantern Room.
From now on The Lantern Room is calm side up: flip it now (do not add clues), and in every later loop it enters play calm side up.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-ninthdeath.text:
Part II only.
[action] Investigators at The Keeper's Quarters spend 2 [perinv] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside Keeper's Logbook asset. Only an investigator at The Keeper's Quarters may trigger this ability.
Objective – If The Lantern Room's lamp is lit and the investigator who controls Keeper's Logbook is at The Lantern Room, advance.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.flavor: A keeper writes his log at the lamp, by its light. Every line in this one was written in the dark.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.back_flavor: Eight deaths in the keeper's own careful hand, each one dated tonight. Each line records where he fell, and each is a little farther along the beam's path out over the water: eight tries to leave the night by its own light. The ninth line is ruled and waiting.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Keeper's Ninth Death.
Remove Keeper's Logbook from the game.
From now on, when an investigator is defeated, they first place 1 Memory on their investigator card: every death is written down.
From now on, when Elias Warde's [elder] effect heals damage, it also heals 1 horror.
The Lighthouse's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.name: The Keeper's Ninth Death

sthr-act-whythirteen.name: Why Thirteen?
sthr-act-whythirteen.text:
[action] Investigators spend 3 [perinv] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside Parish Register asset. Only an investigator at The Vestry may trigger this ability.
Objective – After the Hourglass advances, if the investigator who controls Parish Register is at The Belfry, advance.
sthr-act-whythirteen.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times at the first occultation. It should toll twelve. Take the register up to the bell and count the strokes against it.
sthr-act-whythirteen.back_flavor: The register lists every service since the church was raised, and every entry ends at twelve. On the night of the first occultation, in a different ink, someone has added a thirteenth stroke, pressed so hard the nib tore the page.
sthr-act-whythirteen.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Thirteenth Toll.
Remove Parish Register from the game.
Hour III no longer raises Dissonance by 2 at a Church location.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-hourwaswrong.name: The Hour Was Wrong
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.text:
Part II only.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: The Flooded Crypt opens. Spawn the set-aside The Bell-Ringer Beneath at The Flooded Crypt.
[action] Investigators at The Flooded Crypt spend 3 [perinv] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside Drowned Page asset. Only an investigator at The Flooded Crypt may trigger this ability.
Objective – If the investigator who controls Drowned Page is at The Vestry, advance.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.flavor: Below the bell, below the water, the church keeps what it was told to keep. Bring it up to the Vestry and read it against the register before the water takes the ink.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.back_flavor: The page is soft as wet cloth, but the ink held. The same almanac, the same night, and a different hour. Someone set the occultation an hour wrong, and the town has been standing in the gap ever since.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Hour Was Wrong.
Remove Drowned Page from the game.
Remove 1 [elderthing] token from the chaos bag for the rest of the campaign.
From now on, Hour IV's Forced ability does not resolve: the road no longer gives way.
The Drowned Church's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-walkbackward.name: Walk It Backward
sthr-act-walkbackward.text: Objective – If one investigator has discovered 3 clues at The Turning, then 1 clue at The Low Bridge, then 1 clue at The Milestones, in that order, during this loop, advance. (With one investigator: 2, then 1, then 1.) (Keep a separate pile of resources from the token pool on this act for each investigator, 1 per clue that counts.)
sthr-act-walkbackward.flavor: The same figures walk it every loop, in the same direction, never arriving.
sthr-act-walkbackward.back_flavor: Walking against them, you see the road the way the walkers never do: from the shore back toward town. The milestones count down instead of up. You will not lose your way on this road again.
sthr-act-walkbackward.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Road Remembers.
Group limit once per loop: moving between The Square and The Milestones does not place doom on the current Hour.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-walksbeside.name: Who Walks Beside You
sthr-act-walksbeside.text:
Part II only.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of The Waiting Congregation and spawn it at The Turning. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Each Echo at The Turning is not Sleepwalking.
Objective – [action] Investigators at The Turning spend 4 [perinv] clues, as a group: Stand Firm. Choose a ready Echo at The Turning and test [wil] or [com] (X), where X is its fight value. If you succeed, exhaust it and advance. If you fail, place the spent clues on The Turning.
[reaction] After an investigator at The Turning evades an Echo there, investigators at The Turning spend 4 [perinv] clues, as a group: Advance.
sthr-act-walksbeside.flavor: Some of them turn to look at you now.
sthr-act-walksbeside.back_flavor: The face under the hood is worn almost smooth, like a step a thousand feet have climbed. You know the coat. You know the ring on the hand that lifts to stop you, worn thin on the inside like an anchor's ring, as if it had held against the pull of a thousand nights. They were here before you, and they looped until there was nothing left to loop.
sthr-act-walksbeside.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: Who Walks Beside You.
Remove 1 [cultist] token from the chaos bag for the rest of the campaign.
While your Campaign Log records Who Walks Beside You, each Echo gets −1 fight.
The Sunken Road's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-sheriffdead.name: The Sheriff Is Already Dead
sthr-act-sheriffdead.text: Objective – If one investigator is at The Well and another is at The Town Hall Steps, the investigators may, as a group, spend 3 [perinv] clues to advance. (With one investigator: you are at The Town Hall Steps and were at The Well earlier this round.)
sthr-act-sheriffdead.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. To prove it, see him in two places at once.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.back_flavor: He is at the bottom of the Well, and he has been there since ten o'clock. Up on the Town Hall steps, the sheriff clears his throat and begins the speech again.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Sheriff Is Already Dead.
From now on The Town Hall Steps are calm side up: flip them now (do not add clues), and in every later loop they enter play calm side up.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-vote.name: The Vote That Never Ends
sthr-act-vote.text:
Part II only.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: Spawn the set-aside What Wears the Sheriff at The Town Hall Steps.
[action] Investigators at The Records Office spend 2 [perinv] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside Town Ledger asset. Only an investigator at The Records Office may trigger this ability.
Objective – If the investigator who controls Town Ledger is at The Town Hall Steps, advance.
sthr-act-vote.flavor: The Records Office keeps every decision the town ever made. The speech on the steps is one of them, read again every night.
sthr-act-vote.back_flavor: The minutes are dated the night of the first occultation. A motion to open the door, that Ambergrove should never be forgotten. Every name in the town, each in its own hand. Carried, unanimous. Under the tally the clerk has written: the cost to be settled at the appointed hour. Beneath it, in another hand and a brown ink: and the hour to be printed one late. The name it was called by, the minutes say, is kept in the Almanac House, in the study, under seal.
sthr-act-vote.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Vote That Never Ends. If Seraphine Vale is one of your investigators, mark Seraphine's thread “suspected.”
Remove Town Ledger from the game.
From now on, The Same Speech deals no extra horror for completed loops: you know what the speech is asking for.
The Square's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-wheelturns.name: The Wheel Still Turns
sthr-act-wheelturns.text: Objective – [action] Investigators at The Wheel spend 3 [perinv] clues, as a group, and place 2 doom on the current Hour: Ride to the top. Advance. Only an investigator at The Wheel may trigger this ability.
sthr-act-wheelturns.flavor: You see the whole town at once. One turn of the wheel takes the time it takes.
sthr-act-wheelturns.back_flavor: From the top of the Wheel, Ambergrove lies spread out like a map on a table: the Square, the church, the road running out to the lighthouse. Every street is full, and nobody is moving. Every clock you can see agrees with the others, and the stars are an hour ahead of all of them.
sthr-act-wheelturns.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Wheel Still Turns.
From now on, while your Campaign Log records The Wheel Still Turns: [free]: Look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and put them back in any order. Only an investigator at The Wheel may trigger this ability. Group limit once per loop.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-bargain.name: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain
sthr-act-bargain.text:
Part II only.
Objective – [action] Parley. Investigators at The Ticket Booth pay a fare of 5 [perinv], as a group, in any mix of clues (1 each), Memory removed from their own cards (1 each) and resources (3 count as 1): Advance. Only an investigator at The Ticket Booth may trigger this ability.
sthr-act-bargain.flavor: He smiles at you like he's been expecting you for a very long time.
sthr-act-bargain.back_flavor: He does not ask your name. He tells you there is a way out of the night, that the fare is steep, and that he has waited a very long time for someone who could afford it.
sthr-act-bargain.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain.
The Fairground's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-almanachid.name: What the Almanac Hid
sthr-act-almanachid.text:
[action] Investigators spend 4 [perinv] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside Bound Almanac asset. Only an investigator at The Reading Room may trigger this ability.
Objective – If the investigator who controls Bound Almanac is at The Press, advance.
sthr-act-almanachid.flavor: A hundred copies, every one open at the same page. One is not like the others.
sthr-act-almanachid.back_flavor: One copy in the hundred was pulled from the press before the type was changed. On it the hour of the occultation is struck through by hand, and a later hour written above it in brown ink. You set the type to match the proof and run the press. The pages come out warm, the hour on them blank where the struck line was. For a moment the sky over the Almanac House looks almost ordinary.
sthr-act-almanachid.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: What the Almanac Hid.
Remove Bound Almanac from the game.
At Hour VI, the chaos bag holds 1 fewer Static token for the rest of the loop instead of 1 more.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-appointedname.name: The Appointed's Name
sthr-act-appointedname.text:
Part II only, once your Campaign Log records What the Almanac Hid and The Vote That Never Ends.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: The Sealed Study opens.
Objective – While The Appointed's Approach is Arrived, investigators at The Sealed Study may, as a group, spend 2 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-appointedname.flavor: The minutes said where the name was kept. The page is blank until its owner is near.
sthr-act-appointedname.back_flavor: It is written once, in the middle of an otherwise blank page. You read it. You do not say it aloud. Somewhere on the hill, something pauses mid-step.
sthr-act-appointedname.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Appointed's Name. If Seraphine Vale is one of your investigators, mark Seraphine's thread “known.”
Remove 1 [tablet] token from the chaos bag for the rest of the campaign.
At Hour VII, exhaust The Appointed.
Also record The Way the Night Breaks: the finale may now be begun.
The Almanac House's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-lasthour.name: Contest the Crossing
sthr-act-lasthour.text:
Objective – Gain 1 contest progress each time an investigator succeeds at Hold Back or spends a deep Knowledge entry. Other sources are in the Campaign Guide. When progress reaches 6 (5 with one investigator, 7 with four), advance.
[action]: Spend a deep Knowledge entry your Campaign Log records (each entry once per finale).
If Hour IX is reached, every investigator is defeated, or Dissonance reaches the reset value, the finale ends and the contest is not reached.
sthr-act-lasthour.flavor: An appointment made in ink and never kept.
sthr-act-lasthour.back_flavor: The crossing holds. For one long breath the night stops pressing, and every clock in Ambergrove agrees on the time.
sthr-act-lasthour.back_text: The contest is reached. The investigators must decide how to end the night: turn to the Finale Resolutions in the Campaign Guide and choose one resolution from R1, R1b, R2, R3 or R4 whose condition you meet (R4 is always available).

sthr-res-1.name: Take Its Place
sthr-res-1.text:
Contest reached, and an Ancient investigator, or the investigator who signed the ninth line, is present.
Choose one such present investigator: they become the night's new anchor, kept behind, decades older, so the loop ends for everyone else. Mark them kept as anchor.
If your Campaign Log records Who Walks Beside You, instead: at dawn the anchor walks out with the others, free and not kept, 3 Years older (1 Year if the walkers keep their ring).

sthr-res-2.name: Close the Door
sthr-res-2.text:
Contest reached, and your Campaign Log records The vote still stands.
You pay the price the town agreed to and never paid: each present investigator gains 3 Years (2 if the town was warned), and the door closes.

sthr-res-3.name: Break Through
sthr-res-3.text:
Contest reached, and your Campaign Log records The Keeper's Ninth Death.
Every present investigator escapes along the keeper's path and gains 2 Years. Unless the ninth line was left blank, the loop is only paused.

sthr-res-4.name: Seal by Force
sthr-res-4.text:
Contest reached.
The investigators choose one present investigator: they age out holding the door shut. If the vote was torn out, they instead gain 3 Years and walk away.

sthr-res-5.name: Next Time
sthr-res-5.text:
Contest not reached, and banked Memory is at least 4 per investigator.
Mark this loop Closed at the Hour, read each placed district's resolution (except one whose Resolution 1 you read before the finale), and proceed to Between Loops; the finale may be begun again.

sthr-res-6.name: The Loop Wins
sthr-res-6.text:
Contest not reached, and banked Memory is below 4 per investigator.
The night takes you. The campaign ends.
sthr-res-6.flavor: The town keeps repeating — and somewhere on the Sunken Road, walking the same direction and never arriving, there are new faces beneath the hoods.

sthr-story-actii.name: The Shape of the Hour
sthr-story-actii.text:
Read at Between Loops when Part II begins (3 or more surface Knowledge entries recorded, or Loop 3 completed).
The town has begun to notice that you notice. Somewhere past the edge of the Square, something that has been waiting politely decides to stop waiting. From the next loop, each district's second objective opens, the Appointed's Whispers join the encounter deck, and the Named enter the night.

sthr-story-beforefinale.name: Before the Finale
sthr-story-beforefinale.text: You know the shape of the night now. You know what it costs to end it. Something has held this night in place all along, the way an anchor holds against the tide. The only question left is who pays.
sthr-story-beforefinale.flavor: You have lived this night more times than you can hold.

sthr-res-bargain.name: Let It In, On Your Terms
sthr-res-bargain.text:
Contest reached, your Campaign Log records The Ticket-Taker's Bargain and You hold the ticket, and banked Memory is at least 4 per investigator (3 per investigator if you kept the night to yourselves).
The door opens on your terms and the night finally ends. Banked Memory drops to 0, and each present investigator gains 2 Years.
sthr-res-bargain.flavor: He punches your ticket without looking. He has been expecting you for a very long time.

sthr-bandonsteps.name: The Band on the Steps
sthr-bandonsteps.text:
Sleepwalking.
Spawn – The Town Hall Steps.
While The Band on the Steps is not Sleepwalking, investigators at its location cannot play events.
sthr-bandonsteps.flavor: The tune never reaches its last bar.

sthr-drownedverger.name: The Drowned Verger
sthr-drownedverger.text:
Aloof.
Spawn – The Vestry.
Forced – After you discover a clue at The Vestry: If The Drowned Verger is at The Vestry, ready and unengaged, it engages you.
sthr-drownedverger.flavor: He still keeps the register. He does not like it read.

sthr-milecounter.name: The Mile-Counter
sthr-milecounter.text:
Hunter.
Spawn – The Milestones.
Forced – After The Mile-Counter moves: Place 1 resource on it from the token pool. If there are 3 or more resources on it, remove them and place 1 doom on the current Hour.
sthr-milecounter.flavor: It counts every stone on the road. Every third stone, the hour slips a little further.

sthr-barker.name: The Barker
sthr-barker.text:
Hunter.
Prey – Most resources.
Spawn – The Ticket Booth.
Forced – After The Barker attacks you: Lose 2 resources.

sthr-compositor.name: The Compositor
sthr-compositor.text:
Retaliate.
Spawn – The Press.
Forced – After an investigator at The Compositor's location fails a skill test: Raise Dissonance by 1. (Limit once per round.)
sthr-compositor.flavor: He sets the same page every night, and every night he changes the same line.

sthr-uninvited.name: The Uninvited
sthr-uninvited.text:
Hunter.
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
Forced – After The Uninvited is defeated: Gain 1 contest progress. Remove it from the game.
sthr-uninvited.flavor: It followed the guest in. It has not been asked to leave.

sthr-bellringer.text:
Retaliate.
Spawn – The Flooded Crypt.
Forced – After the Hourglass advances to Hour III: Ready The Bell-Ringer Beneath. It attacks the nearest investigator at its location or a connecting location (the lead investigator breaks ties).
Forced – When The Bell-Ringer Beneath is defeated: Until the end of the loop, Hour III's Forced ability does not resolve.

sthr-appointed-approach.text:
The Approach advances only when an effect says so: Hour V (to at least Sensed), Hour VII (at least Emerging), Hour VIII (Arrived); Dissonance entering the Glitch band (at least Sensed) or the Noticed band (Arrived); The Crossing and The Debt of Hours (1 stage); finale setup (Arrived). It never goes above Arrived.
When the Approach becomes Sensed or later while The Appointed is set aside, put it into play at the revealed location farthest from all investigators that is not closed (the lead investigator breaks ties). When the Approach is pushed back to Unseen, set The Appointed aside.
While the Approach is Sensed, The Appointed gains aloof and cannot move or attack.
Forced – At the end of the round, if the Approach is Sensed: The Appointed deals 1 horror to each investigator at its location.
While the Approach is Emerging, The Appointed gains hunter and cannot attack.
Forced – After The Appointed engages an investigator, if the Approach is Emerging: The Appointed deals 1 horror to that investigator.
While the Approach is Arrived, The Appointed gains hunter.
Forced – After The Appointed attacks, if the Approach is Arrived: Raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-appointed-approach.name: The Appointed's Approach
sthr-appointed-approach.flavor: First a rumor. Then a footstep. Then a knock.

sthr-itmeanswait.text:
Dr. Ayako Sōma deck only.
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card. Cancel its revelation effect and take 1 horror.
If there are 3 or more banked Memory, you may instead play It Means 'Wait' when an Hour's Forced ability (other than Hour IX's) or an attack by The Appointed against you would resolve. Cancel that ability or attack, and raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-dejavu.text: Fast. Play during your turn, after you resolve an [action], [free] or [reaction] ability on an asset or investigator card you control, if that ability has not reached its limit. As an additional cost to play The Same Doorway Twice, raise Dissonance by 1. Resolve that ability again, paying its costs again except [action] and any cost to exhaust a card. This counts toward its limits.
sthr-dejavu.name: The Same Doorway Twice
sthr-dejavu.flavor: You have walked through this doorway before.

sthr-thistimeforsure.text: Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test. As an additional cost to play This Time For Sure, raise Dissonance by 1 unless your Campaign Log records a Knowledge entry for the district you are in. You do not fail: return each revealed chaos token to the chaos bag and resolve that skill test again from its “reveal chaos token” step, with the same cards committed (no more can be committed). Effects of the first revealed tokens stay resolved. You get +2 skill value for this test.

sthr-markeddeck.text:
Cass Lindqvist deck only.
[free] Exhaust Marked Deck: Reveal a random chaos token without resolving it and seal it on Marked Deck. The next time you would reveal a chaos token this round, resolve the sealed token instead. Release it after that test, or at the end of the round.
[free] Exhaust Marked Deck, raise Dissonance by 1 and remove 1 Memory from a card you control: As above, but choose a number token in the chaos bag to seal. (Limit once per loop.)

sthr-compass.text:
“Birdie” Okonkwo deck only.
[action] Exhaust Lucky Compass: Disengage from each non-Elite enemy engaged with you, then move to a connecting location. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[action] Exhaust Lucky Compass and remove 1 Memory from it: Move to any revealed location in a district whose Knowledge entry your Campaign Log records. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

sthrcass.text:
[free] Spend 2 resources: Name a symbol token other than [autofail]. The next time you reveal a token with that symbol during a skill test this round, cancel it (it has no modifier and no symbol effect). (Limit once per round.)
[reaction] After you reveal a symbol token during a skill test: Place 1 Memory on Cass Lindqvist. (Limit once per round, and 3 times per loop.)
[elder] effect: +1. Gain 1 resource for each Memory on Cass Lindqvist (maximum 3).
sthrcass.elderSign: +1. Gain 1 resource for each Memory on Cass Lindqvist (maximum 3).
sthrcass.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 cards of any other class at level 0, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Marked Deck, Seen This Hand Before, The House Always Wins, 1 random basic weakness.

sthrayako.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at an [int] test: Place 1 Memory on Dr. Ayako Sōma. (Limit once per round, and 3 times per loop.)
[elder] effect: +2. Draw 1 card. If it is a Recollection, it costs 2 fewer resources to play until the end of the round.
sthrayako.elderSign: +2. Draw 1 card. If it is a Recollection, it costs 2 fewer resources to play until the end of the round.
sthrayako.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Mystic cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Lexicon of the Hour, It Means 'Wait', Untranslatable, 1 random basic weakness.

sthr-eighthgrave.text: Revelation – If there is Memory on Elias Warde, take 1 horror for each Memory on him (maximum 2), then remove 1 Memory from him. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for an Echo enemy and spawn it engaged with you; it is not Sleepwalking this loop. If you cannot, take 2 horror. Shuffle the encounter deck.

sthr-longwayround.text: Move to a connecting location. Then, you may move to a connecting location. The first of these moves along a district connection does not place doom on the current Hour and does not count as the first move along that connection this round (limit once per loop). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

sthrbirdie.text:
[reaction] After you fail a skill test by 2 or more: Place 1 Memory on “Birdie” Okonkwo. (Limit once per round, and 3 times per loop.)
[reaction] When you would fail a skill test (even because of [autofail]), remove 3 Memory from “Birdie” Okonkwo: You succeed at that test by 0 instead. (Limit once per loop.)
[elder] effect: +1. If you have already failed a skill test this round, this token is +3 instead.
sthrbirdie.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 other Guardian, Mystic, Rogue and/or Seeker cards level 0–1, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lucky Compass, I Get Out, Nobody Believes Her, 1 random basic weakness.
sthrbirdie.elderSign: +1. If you have already failed a skill test this round, this token is +3 instead.

sthr-nobodybelieves.text: Revelation – Take 1 horror. Until the end of the round, other investigators' card abilities cannot choose or affect you or cards you control, and other investigators cannot commit cards to your skill tests. If no other investigator is at your location, take 1 additional horror.

sthr-debtofhours.text: Revelation – If Dissonance is in the Noticed band, advance The Appointed's Approach by 1 stage; if the Approach is already Arrived, take 2 horror instead. Otherwise, if Dissonance is in the Glitch band, take 2 horror. Otherwise, raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-foreknowledge.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
When you commit Foreknowledge to a skill test, you may remove 1 Memory from a card you control. If you do, Foreknowledge gains [wild][wild] for that test, and if that test succeeds, draw 1 card.

sthr-donebefore.text:
Elias Warde deck only.
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. If you have already failed a test of the same skill during this loop, I've Done This Before gains [wild][wild].

sthr-musclememory.text: When you commit Muscle Memory to a skill test, if you have already performed a test of the same skill during this loop, Muscle Memory gains [wild] and you draw 1 card. If it is a [com] or [agi] test and you are Weathered or older, Muscle Memory gains another [wild].
sthr-musclememory.flavor: The body ages. The muscle remembers.

sthr-rememberending.text:
Seraphine Vale deck only.
Test [wil] (X), where X is Dissonance (minimum 2). If you succeed, look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. You may raise Dissonance by 1 to place 1 of them on the bottom of the encounter deck. Place the rest on top in any order.
Max once per loop.

sthr-seenthishand.text:
Cass Lindqvist deck only.
Fast. Play when a chaos token is revealed during a skill test you are performing. Cancel that token (it has no modifier and no effect, even if it is [autofail]). Then, gain 1 resource, or 2 resources if it was a symbol token.

sthrelias.text:
[reaction] When another investigator at your location would be dealt damage that is not direct damage: That damage is dealt to Elias Warde instead. (Limit once per round.)
[reaction] After an enemy attack or Elias Warde's [reaction] ability deals damage to him: Place 1 Memory on Elias Warde. (Limit once per round, and 3 times per loop.)
[elder] effect: +1. If there are 3 or more Memory on Elias Warde, this token is +3 instead, and heal 1 damage from Elias Warde.
sthrelias.elderSign: +1. If there are 3 or more Memory on Elias Warde, this token is +3 instead, and heal 1 damage from Elias Warde.
sthrelias.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Survivor cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Ambergrove Lamp, I've Done This Before, The Eighth Grave, 1 random basic weakness.

sthr-lexicon.text:
Dr. Ayako Sōma deck only.
Uses (0 secrets).
[reaction] After you succeed at an [int] test by 2 or more: Place 1 secret on The Lexicon of the Hour (maximum 4).
[free] Exhaust The Lexicon of the Hour and spend 1 secret: You get +2 [int] for this skill test.
[reaction] When a non-weakness treachery is drawn at your location, exhaust The Lexicon of the Hour and spend 2 secrets: Cancel its revelation effect. (Limit once per loop.)

sthr-bell.text:
Seraphine Vale deck only.
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust The Bell of Ambergrove and spend 1 charge: Evade, using [wil] instead of [agi]. If you succeed, each investigator at your location heals 1 horror.
[action] Exhaust The Bell of Ambergrove, spend 1 charge and raise Dissonance by 2: Advance or rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour. This ability cannot be triggered during the finale. (Limit once per loop.)

sthr-borrowedtime.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
Uses (2 charges). These charges are not Memory.
[free] During your turn, exhaust Stolen Minute and spend 1 charge: Gain 1 additional action this turn.
[reaction] After the Hourglass advances: Place 1 charge on Stolen Minute (maximum 2). (Limit once per loop.)
sthr-borrowedtime.name: Stolen Minute

sthr-housewins.text:
Hunter.
Spawn – Location with the most clues.
While Cass Lindqvist has more Memory on her cards than any other investigator has on theirs, The House Always Wins cannot be evaded.
Forced – When an attack by The House Always Wins defeats an investigator: Remove 3 banked Memory.

sthr-igetout.text:
“Birdie” Okonkwo deck only.
Fast. Play when you would be defeated by damage and/or horror. You are not defeated: heal damage and horror from you until you have 1 remaining health and 1 remaining sanity. Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a connecting location. If you control Lucky Compass, place 1 Memory on it. If it is your turn, end your turn.
Max once per loop.

sthrseraphine.text:
[free] During your turn, raise Dissonance by 1: Choose one – You get +2 skill value for this skill test; or gain 1 additional action this turn; or ready a Spell asset you control. (Limit twice per round.)
[reaction] After you resolve Seraphine Vale's [free] ability: Place 1 Memory on Seraphine Vale. (Limit once per round, and 3 times per loop.)
[elder] effect: +X, where X is Dissonance (maximum +5). After this skill test ends, lower Dissonance by the amount this token added.
sthrseraphine.elderSign: +X, where X is Dissonance (maximum +5). After this skill test ends, lower Dissonance by the amount this token added.
sthrseraphine.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 Seeker cards level 0–2, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Bell of Ambergrove, I Remember the Ending, The Debt of Hours, 1 random basic weakness.

sthr-lamp.text:
Elias Warde deck only.
Each investigator at your location gets +1 [agi] while evading.
[action] Exhaust The Ambergrove Lamp: Look at the top card of the encounter deck. You may take 1 horror to put it on the bottom. Then, you may move to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
You may also raise Dissonance by 1 (limit once per loop). If you do, that move does not place doom on the current Hour.

sthr-rehearsedescape.text: Evade. Automatically evade a non-Elite enemy engaged with you. As an additional cost, you may raise Dissonance by 1 to choose an Elite enemy engaged with you instead (limit once per loop).

sthr-hourlearnedname.text:
Parley. Choose an enemy at your location.
If it is The Appointed: resolve its Hold Back as if you had succeeded at the test (a Hold Back success). If your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name, push The Appointed's Approach back 1 additional stage.
Otherwise: Test [wil] (3). If you succeed, disengage and exhaust it. If it is non-Elite, it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
Max once per loop.

sthr-cassandrasnotebook.text:
[action] Exhaust Cassandra's Notebook: Investigate. You get +1 [int] for this investigation. If you succeed, draw 1 card.
[reaction] After a Knowledge entry is recorded in your Campaign Log for the first time: Draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources. Then, you may place 1 Memory on Cassandra's Notebook.

sthr-appointedwhisper.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Take 1 horror. If The Appointed's Approach is Emerging or Arrived, take 2 horror instead and raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-appointed.text:
Prey – Most Memory on their cards only.
The Appointed cannot be attacked, evaded, damaged or defeated, and leaves play only when its Approach is pushed back to Unseen.
[action] If The Appointed is ready: Hold Back. Test [wil] or [com] (4). This action does not provoke an attack of opportunity from The Appointed. If you succeed, push The Appointed's Approach back 1 stage, disengage and exhaust The Appointed, and rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour (no rewind during the finale, and at most 3 rewinds each loop).

sthr-minutehand.name: The Minute Hand
sthr-minutehand.flavor: It keeps perfect time. It is only ever one minute behind you.

sthr-wearssheriff.text:
Prey – Investigator with Town Ledger only.
Spawn – The Town Hall Steps.
While no investigator controls Town Ledger, What Wears the Sheriff gains aloof and cannot move.
While an investigator controls Town Ledger, What Wears the Sheriff gains hunter.

sthr-onewhorides.text:
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
Spawn – The Wheel.
While The One Who Rides Forever is ready, it cannot be dealt damage.
Forced – When The One Who Rides Forever is defeated: Until the end of the loop, The Wheel's Forced ability does not resolve.

sthr-item-logbook.name: Keeper's Logbook
sthr-item-logbook.text:
[reaction] When you would take 1 or more damage, exhaust Keeper's Logbook: Take 1 less damage.
Forced – When you are eliminated: Place Keeper's Logbook at your location.
[action] If Keeper's Logbook is uncontrolled: Take control of it. Any investigator at its location may trigger this ability.
sthr-item-logbook.flavor: Eight deaths in the keeper's hand, each with its hour and its cause.

sthr-item-register.name: Parish Register
sthr-item-register.text:
While you control Parish Register, The Drowned Verger loses aloof and gains hunter and “Prey – Investigator with Parish Register only.”
[reaction] When The Belfry or Thirteen would raise Dissonance, exhaust Parish Register: Cancel that raise.
Forced – When you are eliminated: Place Parish Register at your location.
[action] If Parish Register is uncontrolled: Take control of it. Any investigator at its location may trigger this ability.
sthr-item-register.flavor: Every service since the church was raised, in faded black ink. Every one ends at twelve.

sthr-item-drownedpage.name: Drowned Page
sthr-item-drownedpage.text:
[reaction] When a treachery card would advance the Hourglass, exhaust Drowned Page: Cancel that advance. Then, place 1 doom on the current Hour.
Forced – When you are eliminated: Place Drowned Page at your location.
[action] If Drowned Page is uncontrolled: Take control of it. Any investigator at its location may trigger this ability.
sthr-item-drownedpage.flavor: The ink has held. The paper barely has. It still says what hour it really is.

sthr-item-ledger.name: Town Ledger
sthr-item-ledger.text:
[action] Exhaust Town Ledger: Choose an Echo at your location. You read its name from the minutes: it is Sleepwalking until the end of the round.
Forced – When you are eliminated: Place Town Ledger at your location.
[action] If Town Ledger is uncontrolled: Take control of it. Any investigator at its location may trigger this ability.
sthr-item-ledger.flavor: The minutes of every meeting the town has ever held, and every name in it.

sthr-item-almanac.name: Bound Almanac
sthr-item-almanac.text:
You get −1 [agi].
[reaction] When you reveal a Static token during a skill test, exhaust Bound Almanac: Cancel that token and reveal another.
Forced – When you are eliminated: Place Bound Almanac at your location.
[action] If Bound Almanac is uncontrolled: Take control of it. Any investigator at its location may trigger this ability.
sthr-item-almanac.flavor: The one proof in the hundred, pulled before the type was changed. You carry it flat and careful, as if the hour on it might spill.

sthr-untranslatable.text: Revelation – Take horror equal to half the banked Memory, rounded up (maximum 5).

sthr-anchorpoint.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You get +1 maximum sanity.
Forced – At the start of each loop: Place 1 Memory on your investigator card.

sthr-story-firstdark.text: You wake at First Dark with the taste of salt and the certainty that you have done this before. The others feel it too. No one in Ambergrove will believe you.
